messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — launch freeze starts in 1h for v2.2.2. Can we run through a quick readiness + exception plan?
priya_s: Quick checklist: 1) pin model versions, 2) ensure canary + traffic split, 3) rollback playbook finalised. Do we have any last-minute infra migrations?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-id=canary-2026-03-20-01, targets: 10% traffic to infra-pool-a. Logs: /deploys/canary-2026-03-20-01
samir: Rollback criteria proposal (TL;DR): >1% 5xx over 5m OR P95 latency >600ms OR generation-quality regression >2% on control eval set. If any triggered -> automatic traffic cut to fallback variant, pager notify.
marta_ops: There's a small storage tier compaction scheduled in 30m but it can be postponed. If compaction runs during canary we should mark an exception. Who signs off?
jen_product: Product can sign exceptions for UX regressions only. For infra changes we need ops + releng approval.
liam_releng: Rollback commands (keep handy):
```
# cut traffic to fallback
redwoodctl rollout set-traffic --deployment v2.2.1 --percent 100
# pin old model
redwoodctl model pin --service inference --model v2.2.1
# force rollback
redwoodctl deploy rollback --deployment v2.2.2 --to v2.2.1
```
priya_s: Pin request: pin model variant crc-7e3a for this change window (will reduce drift for evals). Command I ran: `redwoodctl model pin --service inference --model crc-7e3a --reason "launch freeze pin"` — logs in infra:ops channel.
marta_ops: Acknowledged, adding exception record to launch-readiness.md and toggling `change_window:active` flag in the deploy console.
alex_k: I'll be on-call for the next 3 hours monitoring canary. If we hit criteria, I'll trigger rollback and notify SRE + product. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ 10m: 5xx=0.18% (OK), P95=420ms (OK), request-rate stable. No quality regressions detected on the sampled eval set.
priya_s: Thanks — please keep the pinned model and the rollback commands pinned in the thread. If anyone needs an exception after freeze, post approval from ops+releng.
liam_releng: One more note — if we need an emergency DB schema change, follow the two-step: migrate-read-only -> verify telemetry -> migrate-write with 30m maintenance window. That requires explicit approvals in this thread.
alex_k: LGTM. Proceeding in 5 min unless objections. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
